summary_en: Post-adjustment figures confirmed for commitment-type share buyback (FCSR) adjustment period ①: average purchase price 5,924.1775 yen, shares acquired 16,231,700, adjustment shares decreased by 641,600 through warrant exercise.
title_en: Notice of Post-Adjustment in Commitment-Type Share Buyback (FCSR)
translation_en_brief: This announcement reports the finalization of post-adjustment figures for an adjustment period under Shin-Etsu Chemical's commitment-type share buyback (FCSR) program announced on July 24, 2026. The average purchase price was calculated at 5,924.1775 yen, determined as the arithmetic mean of volume-weighted average prices (VWAP) from July 31 to September 14, 2026, multiplied by a factor of 98.493%. The company acquired 16,231,700 shares through ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading from Nomura Securities on July 30, 2026, representing one-half of the shares purchased at that transaction. The adjustment resulted in a reduction of 641,600 shares compared to the theoretical share count that would have been acquired at the average price using one-half of the transaction amount. These adjustment shares were distributed to warrant holders through the exercise of share warrants.
